#### Biomass {.tabset .tabset-dropdown}

In the experiment we studied two-patch meta-ecosystems in which we manipulated the size of their patches and their connection (unconnected vs connected). Now, we want to know whether meta-ecosystem size influenced the effects of connection on this response variable. Therefore, we start by looking at how this response variable changed across time for all meta-ecosystems through its mean ± 95 confidence interval:

```{r fig.height = figures_height_rmd_output, fig.width = figures_width_rmd_output}

# --- PLOT ORIGINAL DATA MEAN ± 95 % CI --- #

ggarrange(plot.metaecos.legend(ds_metaecosystems %>% filter(disturbance_percentage == "fixed"),
                              response_variable_selected),
          plot.metaecos.points(ds_metaecosystems %>% filter(disturbance_percentage == "fixed"),
                               response_variable_selected)  +
            rremove("xlab") +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                  legend.position = "none") +
            font("legend.text", size = size_legend) +
            font("ylab", size = size_y_axis) + 
            ggtitle(fixed_label),
          plot.metaecos.points(ds_metaecosystems %>% 
                                 filter(disturbance_percentage == "decreasing_with_size"),
                               response_variable_selected)  +
            font("xlab", size = size_y_axis) +
            font("ylab", size = size_y_axis) +
            scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(ds_metaecosystems$day)) +
            theme(legend.position = "none") +
            ggtitle(relative_label),
          heights = c(0.25, 0.6, 0.6),
          nrow = 3,
          align = "v")
```

```{r}

# --- PREPARE DATA FOR ANALYSIS --- #

# Add baselines

baseline = ds_metaecosystems %>%
  filter(time_point == time_point_of_baselines) %>%
  select(system_nr,
         all_of(response_variable_selected)) %>%
  rename(baseline = all_of(response_variable_selected))

data_for_analysis = ds_metaecosystems %>%
  left_join(baseline)

# Filter and mutate

data_for_analysis = data_for_analysis %>%
  filter(time_point >= first_time_point_model,
         time_point <= last_time_point_model,
         !is.na(!!sym(response_variable_selected)),
         connection == "connected" | 
          ecosystems_combined %in% unconnected_metaecosystems_selected) %>%
  mutate(conn = factor(x = ifelse(connection == "connected", 
                                  "con", 
                                  "unconnected"),
                       levels = c("unconnected", "con")))
```

```{r}

# --- CREATE MODEL --- #

# Prepare data

data_for_analysis = data_for_analysis %>% 
  rename(size = ecosystem_size_ml,
         dis_per = disturbance_percentage) %>%
  mutate(size = as.factor(size),
         day = as.factor(day))

# In the ouput lmerModLmerTest which means that it's a Linear Mixed Model from the lmerTest package

basic_model = lmer(get(response_variable_selected) ~
               size * conn * dis_per +
               (1 | system_nr) +
               (1 | baseline) + 
               (1 | day),
             data = data_for_analysis,
             REML = FALSE,
             control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"))

# Extract residuals from the basic model

data_for_analysis$residuals <- resid(basic_model)

# Fit a new model with varIdent

model <- gls(residuals ~ 
               size * conn * dis_per,
             data = data_for_analysis,
             weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1 | day))

model <-gls(bioarea_mm2_per_ml ~ size * conn * dis_per, 
          data = data_for_analysis,
          weights = varIdent(form =~ 1 | day * system_nr * baseline)) #Best size * dis_per * day + system_nr + 
```

<details>
<summary>Model residuals coding</summary>
```{r}

# --- CODE MODEL RESIDUALS --- #

emmeans_output = emmeans(model,
                         specs = ~  conn * dis_per * size,
                         adjust = "sidak",
                         bias.adj = TRUE,
                         lmer.df = "satterthwaite") 

emmeans_output

uncon_decr_6_43 = c(1, rep(0,15)) 
con_decr_6_43 = c(rep(0,1), 1, rep(0,14)) 
uncon_fix_6_43 = c(rep(0,2), 1, rep(0,13)) 
con_fix_6_43 = c(rep(0,3), 1, rep(0,12)) 
uncon_decr_9 = c(rep(0,4), 1, rep(0,11)) 
con_decr_9 = c(rep(0,5), 1, rep(0,10)) 
uncon_fix_9 = c(rep(0,6), 1, rep(0,9)) 
con_fix_9 = c(rep(0,7), 1, rep(0,8)) 
uncon_decr_15 = c(rep(0,8), 1, rep(0,7))
con_decr_15 = c(rep(0,9), 1, rep(0,6))
uncon_fix_15 = c(rep(0,10), 1, rep(0,5))
con_fix_15 = c(rep(0,11), 1, rep(0,4))
uncon_decr_45 = c(rep(0,12), 1, rep(0,3))
con_decr_45 = c(rep(0,13), 1, rep(0,2))
uncon_fix_45 = c(rep(0,14), 1, rep(0,1))
con_fix_45 = c(rep(0,15), 1)

n_of_digits = 3
contrasts = contrast(emmeans_output, 
                     method = list("6.43 ml - decreasing % with size" = con_decr_6_43 - uncon_decr_6_43,
                                   "9.00 ml - decreasing % with size" = con_decr_9 - uncon_decr_9,
                                   "15.00 ml - decreasing % with size" = con_decr_15 - uncon_decr_15,
                                   "45.00 ml - decreasing % with size" = con_decr_45 - uncon_decr_45,
                                   "6.43 ml - fixed % with size" = con_fix_6_43 - uncon_fix_6_43,
                                   "9.00 ml - fixed % with size" = con_fix_9 - uncon_fix_9,
                                   "15.00 ml - fixed % with size" = con_fix_15 - uncon_fix_15,
                                   "45.00 ml - fixed % with size" = con_fix_45 - uncon_fix_45)) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(p.value = round(p.value, digits = n_of_digits),
         estimate = round(estimate, digits = n_of_digits),
         SE = round(SE, digits = n_of_digits),
         df = round(df, digits = n_of_digits),
         t.ratio = round(t.ratio, digits = n_of_digits),
         e = "",
         e = ifelse(p.value > 0.1, 
                           "",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, 
                           "*",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.01, 
                           "**",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, 
                           "***",
                           e)) %>%
  rename(" " = e)
```
